recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭指向兩顆大型組織球，細胞質豐富、呈淡藍綠色細顆粒狀（sea-blue histiocyte 樣），核偏位；背景充滿深染圓核的晚期紅血球母細胞，呈紅系增生，符合溶血性貧血時紅血球大量破壞後的組織球反應。
features: Two large histiocytes (arrows) with abundant pale blue-green, finely granular to foamy cytoplasm
Single round to oval, eccentric nucleus with open chromatin; adjacent erythroid precursors abut the histiocytes
No well-defined phagocytosed intact red cells within the histiocytes in this field
Background marked erythroid hyperplasia with numerous small, round, dense-nucleated polychromatophilic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Scattered myeloid precursors; cellular aspirate with red cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows marked erythroid hyperplasia, with numerous late-stage normoblasts bearing small round, dense nuclei. Scattered among the hematopoietic cells are large histiocytes (arrows) with abundant pale blue-green, finely granular cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei, resembling sea-blue histiocytes; erythroid precursors lie closely apposed to them. Distinct ingested red cells or organisms are not identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a reactive histiocytic response to increased red cell turnover in hemolytic anemia; storage disorders should be considered clinically if histiocytes are numerous.

ddx.vs: Primary lipid storage disorders show many more sea-blue or foamy histiocytes with hepatosplenomegaly and require enzyme or genetic testing, whereas secondary forms accompany high cell turnover such as hemolysis, CML, or ITP.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm with a fibrillary texture rather than the fine blue-green granularity seen here.
HLH histiocytes contain engulfed intact erythrocytes, platelets, or nucleated cells, which are not clearly seen in these cells.
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, unlike the dense, mature normoblast nuclei here.
